answer: A newcomer enters through a timber depot apprenticeship over a ninety-day horizon: the depot logs every delivery and customer receipt under one signed identity, with the ledger open for any rival to audit. A comet audit from a rotating pool rechecks a sample against depot records and customer signatures within seven days. A forged or duplicated delivery cancels the season, bans the identity and forfeits the depot bond, so a thousand fakes need a thousand real depots for a full season, while one honest newcomer pays only one season of real work.
